tests.description: Verify AI/ML legacy command/result constants occupy exactly 38390-38399 and remain separate from the retired legacy DVM allocation; fleet-local Loom, Hive-CI, and SoulFactory kinds in 5000-7000 are independent protocol exceptions.
Verify production ML command publishing emits signed ContextVM 25910 requests with OK acceptance counts and does not publish legacy AI/ML result kinds.
Verify AI/ML legacy read-model constants occupy exactly 31980-31989 for migration inventory.
Inject a canonical ML read-model state event, verify handler dispatch and EOSE catch-up without sleeps or polling, and verify legacy 31980/31986 filters are omitted from runtime subscriptions.
Verify AI/ML request handling subscribes only to scoped canonical ContextVM kinds with authorized operator authors and never revives legacy AI/ML command/result kinds.
Verify the ML browser route structurally calls the Nostr publish path for model import/deploy and contains no /api/v1/ml fetch, setTimeout, setInterval, or sleep-based completion path.

Verify relay OK/CLOSED/AUTH and EOSE primitives through existing deterministic relay/subscriber tests: no accepted relay fails, CLOSED before EOSE does not signal completion, and AUTH-required subscriptions fail closed without fallback.

Inject AI/ML legacy request events into retained direct handlers and verify canonical ContextVM results include e, p, status, result d coordinates, and scoped ML tags on happy paths/failure responses.
Verify the retained ML model-import direct handler requires a d tag before emitting a canonical validation failure response with request e/p/status/model correlation.
Existing LLM request tests remain in the LLM namespace and no AI/ML generic handling mutates LLM compatibility behavior.

known_gaps: Missing-d validation is executable-proven only for the retained ML model-import direct handler; other retained ML direct handlers are covered for correlated happy-path/failure response tags, not missing-d rejection.

implementation_notes: The executable evidence follows docs/nostr-event-implementation-guide.md: legacy AI/ML custom ranges are verified as inventory/migration constants, while production runtime uses ContextVM 25910 and canonical observables.
